GENERAL MEETING SATURDAY MARCH 19TH 2:00-4:00 PM

*Please note that the March General Meeting has been rescheduled for Saturday March 19th, 2-4PM.

Aaron O’Brien will demonstrate improvements to our website and our featured demonstration is our esteemed member John Glass. Monthly meetings are free and open to the general public.

UPCOMING EVENTS 

  • May-June art show at the Cape Cod Community Media Center (CCCMC).
  • June 17 2022-A special member reception is scheduled fr Friday, June 17th that will feature heavy hor’ d’oeuvres provided by displaying artists. More information will be made available. For now, mark your calendars as it will be a unique gathering.
